s: Moses counts the men of Israel able to fight, tribe by tribe. The Levites are kept apart to serve the tabernacle.
How the tribes are to camp around the tabernacle and march.
The Levites take the place of Israel's firstborn and are given their duties.
The tasks of the Levite clans in carrying the tabernacle.
Laws on uncleanness, restitution, and a test for a wife suspected of adultery.
The Nazirite vow. The priestly blessing: The Lord bless you and keep you.
The tribal leaders bring gifts for the dedication of the altar.
The lampstand is lit and the Levites are purified for service.
The second Passover is kept. The cloud over the tabernacle tells Israel when to move and when to stay.
Silver trumpets are made. Israel sets out from Sinai.
The people complain about the manna and crave meat. God shares Moses' spirit with seventy elders and sends quail.
Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses. Miriam is struck with leprosy and healed when Moses prays.
Twelve spies explore Canaan. Ten report that the land cannot be taken, but Caleb urges them on.
The people rebel and want to return to Egypt. God decrees forty years in the desert, and only Joshua and Caleb of that generation will enter.
Laws on offerings. A man who breaks the sabbath is put to death. Tassels remind Israel of the commandments.
Korah, Dathan and Abiram rebel against Moses and Aaron, and the earth swallows them.
Aaron's staff buds, showing that God has chosen him.
The duties and portion of priests and Levites.
The ashes of a red heifer are used to make water for cleansing.
Miriam dies. Moses strikes the rock in anger and is told he will not enter the land. Aaron dies.
Israel wins its first victories. When serpents bite the people, Moses lifts up a bronze serpent and those who look at it live.
Balak, king of Moab, hires Balaam to curse Israel. An angel blocks Balaam's way, and his donkey speaks.
Balaam blesses Israel instead of cursing it, twice.
Balaam blesses Israel a third time and foretells a star rising out of Jacob.
Israel sins with the women of Moab and their god. Phinehas acts with zeal and the plague stops.
A second census of the new generation before entering the land.
The daughters of Zelophehad receive an inheritance. Joshua is appointed to succeed Moses.
The offerings for each day, sabbath and feast.
The offerings for the feasts of the seventh month.
Rules about vows made by women.
Israel takes vengeance on Midian and divides the spoil.
Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh are given land east of the Jordan, if they help conquer Canaan.
A list of Israel's camps from Egypt to the plains of Moab.
The borders of the promised land and the leaders who will divide it.
Cities for the Levites, and cities of refuge for those who kill by accident.
Daughters who inherit must marry within their tribe, so the land stays in the tribe.

21: Those bitten by serpents live when they look at the bronze serpent Moses lifts up. Jesus says he too will be lifted up, so that all who believe may have life.
